title: Testing explicit intent history for non-oracle action availability
decision: Retain causal action history and test whether calibrated hybrid reranking can preserve proposal validity while extracting useful JEPA simulation signal.
plain_summary: Causal action history raised availability accuracy from 81.9% to about 98.2% and length-nine plus-two success from zero to 36.7%, but invalid actions remain frequent and pure JEPA reranking is harmful.
